Hi all — quick pricing & isolation note as requested: 
- Dedicated VPC option: Yes, we offer a private deployment model with customer-managed VPC and dedicated capacity (single-tenant pools). That supports production PHI isolation and aids compliance.
- Ballpark pricing delta: Dedicated private deployment typically runs ~3.5x the hosted API list price for comparable throughput (depends on committed capacity and term). We can run a sizing exercise once we have expected QPS and average context length.
- Migration & encryption: We use AES-256 at-rest and TLS1.3 in transit. Key management can be customer-managed (KMS/HSM) for dedicated/private.

Next steps I will take:
- Upload a short isolation architecture sketch to the shared Drive by EOD Wednesday.
- Help scope sizing questions; propose a call next week with ClearPath infra and their SRE/security folks.
